title: Since I don't have any experience creating trailers, I had an AI plan, record, and edit my first game trailer
author: obsidianterror
selftext:
Hi everyone, I'm currently developing a small puzzle game in Godot that I'll be releasing on Steam. I need a trailer for it, but I don't have the budget to hire a professional, so I asked an AI to do it for me. Here's the result. I used GPT 6.1 Sol High with Codex CLI. I asked the AI to capture some of my levels in their solved state and then render the trailer. I've found that it works really well to record Godot games and have the AI write scripts to control the game inputs.

For what it is, I think it turned out pretty well!
